subject: Throughput shortfall — priority recovery & commercial adjustments
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex@ignite.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Throughput spike impacting production - request for urgent recovery plan

Olga / Ben,

We saw a sustained throughput degradation across our primary region starting 2026-08-19 22:30 UTC that is impacting multiple customer-facing features. Error rates spiked to ~7% and tail latency increased into the 99th percentile (~2.3s) for several minutes. This has produced visible downstream failures in our pipeline and triggered alerts from our ops team.

We need: 1) an immediate timeline for mitigation, 2) an explanation of root cause, and 3) commercial remediation options while we continue to evaluate long-term mitigation.

Our procurement team is asking for a formal request for credits and a tentative number for our finance review. Can you provide an interim compensation proposal so we can brief our CFO? We are open to an executive call today if that helps move things faster.

Attachments: ignite_service_report_aug20.pdf (summary export)

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Reliability
Ignite AI
alex@ignite.ai
+1 415-555-0112
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com

Date: 2026-08-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput spike impacting production - request for urgent recovery plan

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the report. I'm escalating this as high priority.

Quick status: we saw the same anomaly in our telemetry and have an incident task force assigned. Ben is leading the remediation and Dev will pull the detailed logs. Preliminary mitigation steps include throttling low-priority background traffic and shifting affected workloads to a warmed pool to reduce queuing. We expect visible improvement within the next 90 minutes and a stabilizing tail within 4 hours contingent on the remediation playbook.

For credits: we can share a preliminary workback tonight. Ben, Dev — please attach the initial_event_log.csv and the short timeline so Alex and procurement can start finance calculations.

I agree an exec call will help; available windows: 3:00pm or 4:30pm PT today. Alex, please confirm.

—Olga

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T11:00:00-07:00

Alex / Olga — attaching the initial logs we pulled (initial_event_log.csv). Summary timeline below:
- 2026-08-19 22:27 UTC: first queuing anomaly observed on the serving fleet for model-rank-v3.
- 22:30–22:50 UTC: throughput reduced by ~18% due to a combination of KV cache pressure and a kernel fallback that increased per-token compute.
- 22:50–23:10 UTC: autoscale recovered capacity but we saw higher latency due to cold-start traffic spikes on warmed nodes.

Prelim credit calc (very rough while we complete postmortem): we can offer a pro-rated service credit covering the degraded window plus an uplift to account for retries you're likely to have executed. Ballpark: 7–12% of that day's bill for affected routes. I will formalize this in the workback spreadsheet for procurement.

Action items:
- Dev to capture stack traces and kernel fallback traces (in progress).
- Olga to confirm exec call.
- We'll prepare a proposed_credit_workback.xlsx by EOD.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Olga / Ben,

Finance needs a documented credit calculation and a statement of work amendment if the credit impacts committed spend. Please provide: 1) a line-item credit workback by route, 2) affected timestamps in ISO UTC, 3) any upstream retries that should be excluded/included. We have an internal PO reference: PO-3372-IGN.

We would like a timeline for when Redwood will deliver the formal workback and the post-incident report. Ideally both by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-26). If you cannot meet that timeline, please propose the next earliest delivery and an interim credit amount that we can circulate to our CFO for preliminary approval.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
Ignite AI
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Alex Johnson <alex@ignite.ai>, procurement@ignite.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput shortfall — priority recovery & commercial adjustments

Alex / Procurement / Kate — thank you for your patience while we completed the internal analysis and the post-incident notes. Below is our proposed path forward; this is intended to balance speed of remedy with a clear, auditable calculation for credits.

1) Technical recap (short):
- Root cause: an unexpected kernel fallback path triggered by a mismatched quantization shard after a rolling kernel optimization was deployed to the serving pool. This caused a transient increase in per-token latency and KV pressure during a high-concurrency window (22:27–23:05 UTC on 2026-08-19).
- Mitigation completed: rollback of the kernel optimization, re-warm of the affected pool, and a small scheduler patch to prevent the fallback condition. Full RCA doc is linked below and we will deliver a formal postmortem file by 2026-09-02.

2) Commercial proposal (workback summary):
- Affected window: 2026-08-19T22:27:00Z — 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z
- Affected routes: /v1/generate (model-rank-v3), /v1/rerank
- Proposed interim credit: 10% of daily spend for the affected routes for 2026-08-19 (applies only to traffic that received non-2xx responses or experienced >1.5x baseline p99 latency).
- Final credit: to be finalized after our detailed reconciliation; final amount will be the greater of (A) the interim credit above, or (B) the itemized workback calculation (route-by-route) we will deliver in the final workbook.

3) Deliverables & timeline:
- 2026-08-30 EOD PT: itemized proposed_credit_workback.xlsx (route-by-route breakdown, includ. method for retry accounting).
- 2026-09-02 EOD PT: full RCA postmortem and artifact bundle (logs, kernel traces, mitigation timeline).
- Exec sync availability: Wednesday 2026-09-01 10:00am PT or 2:00pm PT. Olga + Ben will join; Dev will bring the technical lead. Please confirm which window works for your CFO/VP.

4) Contract mechanics:
- If procurement confirms PO-3372-IGN covers the credit, we will issue an invoice credit memo once the final reconciliation is accepted. If the credit affects committed reserved capacity, we will prepare an amendment to the committed spend appendix for signature.

Attachments: proposed_credit_workback.xlsx (initial workbook)
Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-9812

We want to keep this partnership moving forward; our goal is to get you a swift interim uplift and a defensible final reconciliation so your finance team can close the book.

—Olga
